text: On 12 May 2025 my landlord Mr. Rao in Vijayawada refused to return my security deposit of Rs 50,000 after I vacated the flat in good condition.
A man called Kiran sold me a second-hand bike for Rs 45,000 in Guntur on 2 June 2025 and later I found it was stolen and the papers were fake.
My employer, Sri Sai Traders in Hyderabad, has not paid my salary of Rs 25,000 per month for March, April and May 2025.
On 3 July 2025 my neighbour Suresh hit me on the head with an iron rod during a quarrel over water in Ongole. I was admitted to the government hospital.
I paid Rs 3,20,000 to Green Homes builders in Bengaluru in 2022 for a flat. Possession promised by December 2023 has not been given and they refuse a refund.
Someone opened a fake Instagram account in my name, Divya, on 18 August 2025 and is posting my morphed photos and messaging my friends for money.
My cousin Ramesh gave me a cheque of Rs 1,00,000 to repay a loan. It bounced on 5 September 2025 due to insufficient funds and he ignores my notice.
On 21 July 2025 a showroom in Chennai sold me a television for Rs 38,000. It stopped working in ten days and they refuse repair under warranty.
My husband Venkat left our home in Nellore in January 2025 and refuses to pay anything for our two daughters' school fees and food, though he earns Rs 60,000 a month.
A loan app called QuickCash keeps calling my relatives in Kurnool and sending abusive messages and my edited photos since 10 August 2025 over a Rs 8,000 loan I already repaid.
On 28 June 2025 my neighbour Lakshmi's sons broke the compound wall of my house in Eluru and dumped construction waste inside my plot.
I paid Rs 75,000 to an agent named Faizal in Hyderabad on 15 April 2025 who promised a railway job. He gave a fake appointment letter and has disappeared.
